cards.card_text: Abraham places the wood for the burnt offering on Isaac, and he carries the fire and the sacrificial ___ himself.
cards.verse_text: He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together.
cards.snippet: He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together.

cards.card_text: Then the women speak up: they burned incense to the Queen of Heaven, poured out drink offerings and made sacrificial cakes in her image.
cards.verse_text: “Moreover,” said the women, “when we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands’ knowledge that we made sacrificial cakes in her image and poured out drink offerings to her?”
cards.snippet: …offerings to her, was it without our husbands’ knowledge that we made sacrificial cakes in her image and poured out drink offerings to her?”

cards.card_text: Ezekiel is to call the birds and beasts to gather from all around for a great sacrificial feast God is preparing for them on the mountains of Israel.
cards.verse_text: And as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Call out to every kind of bird and to every beast of the field: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great feast on the mountains of Israel.
